result_text:
Any folder whose name starts with `mock` or `__mock` now counts as mock resources, whatever the rest of the name is. That covers plain `mock`, `mock.data`, `mock(old)`, `mock-größe` and `mock模拟`. I didn't add tests for the new cases or run them. The only check was the existing convention tests in `codeanalyzer`, which pass.

The change is two regexes in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java` (lines 393–394). Each used `[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+` after `mock`/`__mock`. I replaced that with `[^/\\]*`, which allows any characters, including none, but stops at a path separator.

- **Single folder name:** the match can't run across folders, so `remock/`, `demo/` and `src/main/java/` don't match. Files merely named `mock.java` or `mockery.java` don't match either, because the rule needs a `/` after the folder name.
- **Backslash paths:** `SourceFileFilter.pathMatches` already tries a slash-normalised version of the path, so Windows-style paths work without further changes.
- **Old folders:** `mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/` and `mockStore/` all still match by construction, since the new class is a superset of the old one. I didn't run them.

I didn't commit.
